analysis.aggregate: For each metric and ratio, report all three block values plus median and min-max; do not compute a p-value or population interval.
analysis.block_comparison: Within each block compare Elastic/Fixed and Free/Fixed using wall_time_s, observed_cpu_core_seconds, and observed_memory_gib_seconds.
analysis.metric_source: Use scripts/plot_ear_replay.py so all three arms share the same fail-closed provenance and sampler coverage gates.
analysis.outlier_diagnostic: For each block report exactly one llm-spec-decoding observed CPU core-seconds value per arm, using the same per-container sampled average CPU percent / 100 multiplied by first-to-last sample window; this is an explicitly outcome-informed secondary diagnostic.
analysis.previous_triplet: Exclude the earlier non-random-order triplet from the three-block aggregate.

claim_scope: Outcome-informed c4 development reproducibility check only; the schedule balances ordinal position but not transition or carryover, and supports no population or causal claim.

execution.command_expansion: For each run, take the selected arm_command_templates argv array and replace the single {output_dir} element with the run output_dir string; do not insert, remove, split, or join any other argv element.
execution.stop_condition: Stop immediately if a command exits nonzero or any required after-arm or after-block gate fails.

preflight_gates: The base Free design, manifest, tasks, and pair design SHA256 values match the explicit hashes in this design.
The source trace repository commit matches this design and has no changes to the eight locked trace paths.
The eight source trace SHA256 values and eight Docker image IDs match the maps in the hash-locked base Free design.
The ASB and EAR code commits and EAR policy SHA256 match this design.
No container or sweep fixed image recorded by a prior arm in this experiment remains.

after_all_blocks: Report all three block values plus median and min-max exactly as pre-registered; exclude the earlier exploratory triplet.
after_each_arm_before_next_arm: The command exits zero and throughput reports attempted=completed=8, failed=0, action_count=142, llm_call_count=75, and tool_exec_count=67.
The arm has 67/67 replay tool outcomes matched and zero mismatches.
The arm has one monitored container per completed trace, at least two samples and positive sample-window duration per container, and no sampler errors or drops.
Fixed and Elastic have valid EAR lifecycle artifacts with zero OOM kills, admission rejects, and resize rejects; Free has no EAR runtime metadata, controller summary, or lease events.
No task container ID or sweep fixed image name recorded by this arm remains.
after_each_block_before_next_block: Run scripts/plot_ear_replay.py on this block; its three-arm provenance, role, source-entry, replay-config, and sampler gates pass.
The three throughput summaries have the same 142 actions, 75 LLM calls, and 67 tool executions.
The three mismatch reports have 67/67 matched outcomes, zero mismatches, and the same normalized-output match pattern.
